onboarding.privacyDesc: LifeTrack stores all your health, medication, and schedule data securely on this phone. No accounts, no cloud sync, no tracking.
onboarding.alarmGuaranteeDesc: Uses Android AlarmClock API to ensure medication alarms ring on time even in battery-saver and Doze mode.
onboarding.safetyFirstDesc: Automatic dose gap protection prevents double-dosing, ceiling dose tracking for pain relief, and real-time inventory management.
onboarding.permissionsSubtitle: To never miss a critical medication dose, LifeTrack uses dedicated Android system services.
onboarding.permExactAlarmDesc: Allows firing exact alarms to the exact minute without OS deferrals.
onboarding.permNotificationsDesc: Displays full-screen alarm overlays with sound and vibration.
onboarding.permBatteryDesc: Prevents aggressive phone background task killers from silencing alarms.
onboarding.profileSubtitle: Essential information kept safely on your device for medical emergencies.

shift.title: Shift & Schedule
shift.enabledDescription: Daily routines and medicine alarms dynamically shift with your work rotation.
shift.disabledDescription: Off by default. Enable if you work morning, afternoon, night, or rotating shifts.
shift.featureBody: Designed specifically for healthcare workers, emergency responders, and industrial shift workers. Automatically recalculates wake, meal, and medicine dose times based on your current shift.
shift.bullet1: Repeating multi-step rotation cycles (e.g. 5 Morning, 2 Off, 5 Night)
shift.bullet3: Dose gap collision safety across shift changes
shift.bullet4: 90-Day visual calendar with single-date swap overrides
shift.turnOnMessage: Would you like to automatically adapt your medicine reminders to align with your rotating shift schedule?
shift.turnOffMessage: Turning off the shift schedule will convert any routine-relative medicine reminders into fixed clock times. All reminder history and logs will be safely preserved.
shift.doseGapSafe: All dose schedules maintain required safe intervals across shift transitions.
shift.doseGapWarning: Potential collision detected between shift transitions.
shift.profileDesc: Rotating work cycles, night shifts & 90-day calendar
